lines.text: A gentle answer turns away wrath, and the eyes of the LORD are in every place.
The prayer of the upright is His delight, but the LORD detests the way of the wicked.
Better a dish of vegetables where there is love than a fattened calf with hatred.
The LORD tears down the house of the proud, but He protects the boundaries of the priest.
The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom, and humility comes before honor.
